articles.title_en: Buying voters with uncertain instrumental preferences
articles.title_cn: 以不确定的工具性偏好购买选票
authors: Louis-Sidois, Charles (Vienna University of Economics and Business)
Musolff, Leon Andreas (Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania)
articles.abstract_en: We analyze a vote-buying model where the members of a committee vote on a proposal important to a vote buyer. Each member incurs a privately-drawn disutility if the proposal passes. We characterize the cheapest combination of bribes that guarantees the proposal passes in all equilibria. When members vote simultaneously, the number of bribes is at least 50% larger than the number of votes required to pass the proposal (vote threshold). The number of bribes increases with the dispersion of the disutility distribution and all members are bribed with sufficient dispersion. A proportional increase in the number of members and the vote threshold leads to a less-than-proportional increase in capture cost, and the cost may increase with the vote threshold. With sequential voting and disutility distribution $U[0,1]$, all members are bribed and bribes are equal. Finally, sequential voting increases capture cost in small committees and decreases it in large committees.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析一个买票模型，其中委员会成员就一项对选票购买者重要的提案进行投票。如果提案通过，每位成员都会承担一个私人抽取出的负效用。我们刻画了能够保证提案在所有均衡中通过的最低成本贿赂组合。当成员同时投票时，贿赂数量至少比提案通过所需的票数（投票门槛）多50%。贿赂数量随负效用分布的离散程度增加而增加，并且在离散程度足够大时所有成员都被贿赂。成员数量和投票门槛按比例增加会导致俘获成本以低于比例的方式增加，且成本可能随投票门槛增加而增加。在序贯投票且负效用分布为$U[0,1]$时，所有成员都被贿赂且贿赂相等。最后，序贯投票在小委员会中增加俘获成本，在大委员会中降低俘获成本。

articles.title_en: Existence and uniqueness of solutions to the Bellman equation in stochastic dynamic programming
articles.title_cn: 随机动态规划中贝尔曼方程解的存在性与唯一性
authors: Rincón-Zapatero, Juan Pablo (Departamento de Economía. Universidad Carlos III de Madrid)
Juan Pablo Rincon-Zapatero
articles.abstract_en: In this paper we develop a framework to analyze stochastic dynamic optimization problems in discrete time. We obtain new results about the existence and uniqueness of solutions to the Bellman equation through a notion of Banach contractions that generalizes known results for Banach and local contractions. We apply the results obtained to an endogenous growth model and compare our approach with other well known methods, such as the weighted contraction method, countable local contractions and the Q-transform.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文中，我们建立了一个分析离散时间随机动态优化问题的框架。我们通过一种Banach压缩的概念，获得了关于贝尔曼方程解的存在性与唯一性的新结果，该概念推广了Banach压缩和局部压缩的已知结果。我们将所得结果应用于一个内生增长模型，并将我们的方法与其他著名方法进行了比较，如加权压缩方法、可数局部压缩和Q变换。

articles.title_en: Bayesian social aggregation with almost-objective uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 具有几乎客观不确定性的贝叶斯社会聚合
authors: Pivato, Marcus (Centre d’Économie de la Sorbonne, Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne and THEMA, CY Cergy Paris Université)
Elise Flore, Tchouante Ngamo (Groupe d’Analyse et de Théorie Économique, Université Jean Monnet-St-Etienne and THEMA, CY Cergy Paris Université)
Marcus Pivato
articles.abstract_en: We consider collective decisions under uncertainty, when agents have generalized Hurwicz preferences, a broad class allowing many different ambiguity attitudes, including subjective expected utility preferences. We consider sequences of acts that are “almost-objectively uncertain” in the sense that asymptotically, all agents almost-agree about the probabilities of the underlying events. We introduce a Pareto axiom which applies only to asymptotic preferences along such almost-objective sequences. This axiom implies that the social welfare function is utilitarian, but it does not impose any constraint on collective beliefs. Next, we show that a Pareto axiom restricted to two-valued acts implies that collective beliefs are contained in the closed convex hull of individual beliefs, but imposes no constraints on the social welfare function. Neither axiom entails any link between individual and collective ambiguity attitudes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑不确定性下的集体决策，此时代理人具有广义Hurwicz偏好，这是一类广泛的偏好，允许许多不同的模糊态度，包括主观期望效用偏好。我们考虑“几乎客观不确定”的行为序列，其含义是渐近地，所有代理人对 underlying 事件的概率几乎一致。我们引入一个帕累托公理，它仅适用于沿着此类几乎客观序列的渐近偏好。该公理意味着社会福利函数是功利主义的，但它不对集体信念施加任何约束。接下来，我们表明，限制于二值行为的帕累托公理意味着集体信念包含在个体信念的闭凸包中，但不对社会福利函数施加任何约束。这两个公理都不蕴含个体与集体模糊态度之间的任何联系。

authors: Chambers, Christopher P. (Department of Economics, Georgetown University)
Masatlioglu, Yusufcan (Department of Economics, University of Maryland)
Turansick, Christopher (Georgetown University)
Christopher P. Chambers
Yusufcan Masatlioglu
Christopher Turansick
articles.abstract_en: We study random joint choice rules, allowing for interdependence of choice across agents. These capture random choice by multiple agents, or a single agent across goods or time periods. %Of interest are random joint choice rules which have well defined marginal random choice rules.% as this is necessary for choices to be separable over each dimension. Our interest is in separable choice rules, where each agent can be thought of as acting independently of the other. A random joint choice rule satisfies marginality if for every individual choice set, we can determine the individual's choice probabilities over alternatives independently of the other individual's choice set. We offer two characterizations of random joint choice rules satisfying marginality in terms of separable choice rules. While marginality is a necessary condition for separability, we show that it fails to be sufficient. We provide an additional condition on the marginal choice rules which, along with marginality, is sufficient for separability. (JEL: D01, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究随机联合选择规则，允许不同个体之间选择的相互依赖。这些规则刻画了多个个体的随机选择，或单个个体跨商品或跨时间段的随机选择。%感兴趣的是具有明确定义的边际随机选择规则的随机联合选择规则。%因为这使得选择在每个维度上可分离成为必要。我们的兴趣在于可分离选择规则，其中每个个体可以被视为独立于其他个体行动。一个随机联合选择规则满足边际性，如果对于每个个体选择集，我们能够独立于其他个体的选择集确定该个体对备选方案的选​​择概率。我们根据可分离选择规则，提供了满足边际性的随机联合选择规则的两种刻画。虽然边际性是可分离性的必要条件，但我们表明它并非充分条件。我们提供了关于边际选择规则的一个附加条件，该条件与边际性一起，是可分离性的充分条件。（JEL：D01，D91）

articles.title_en: A theory of fair random allocation under priorities
articles.title_cn: 弱优先级下公平随机分配的理论
authors: Han, Xiang (School of Economics, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics)
articles.abstract_en: In the allocation of indivisible objects under weak priorities, a common practice is to break the ties using a lottery and randomize over deterministic mechanisms. Such randomizations usually lead to unfairness and inefficiency ex-ante. We propose and study the concept of ex-ante fairness for random allocations, extending some key results in the one-sided and two-sided matching markets. It is shown that the set of ex-ante fair random allocations forms a complete and distributive lattice under first-order stochastic dominance relations, and the agent-optimal ex-ante fair mechanism includes both the deferred acceptance algorithm and the probabilistic serial mechanism as special cases. Instead of randomizing over deterministic mechanisms, our mechanism is constructed using the division method, a new general way of constructing random mechanisms from deterministic mechanisms. As additional applications, we demonstrate that several previous extensions of the probabilistic serial mechanism have their foundations in existing deterministic mechanisms.
articles.abstract_cn: 在弱优先级下不可分对象的分配中，一种常见做法是使用抽签打破平局，并在确定性机制上随机化。这种随机化通常会导致事前的不公平和低效率。我们提出并研究随机分配的事前公平概念，扩展了单边和双边匹配市场中的一些关键结果。研究表明，事前公平随机分配的集合在一阶随机占优关系下形成一个完备且分配的格，且代理人最优的事前公平机制将延迟接受算法和概率串行机制都作为特例包含在内。我们的机制不是通过在确定性机制上随机化来构造，而是使用除法方法构造，这是一种从确定性机制构造随机机制的新的一般方法。作为额外应用，我们证明先前若干概率串行机制的扩展都建立在现有确定性机制的基础之上。

articles.title_cn: 具有社会偏好的有效激励
authors: Daske, Thomas (Department of Economics and Policy, Technical University of Munich)
March, Christoph (Department of Economics, University of Bamberg)
Christoph March
articles.abstract_en: We explore mechanism design with outcome-based social preferences. Agents' social preferences and private payoffs are all subject to asymmetric information. We assume quasi-linear utility and independent types. We show how the asymmetry of information about agents' social preferences can be operationalized to satisfy agents' participation constraints. Our main result is a possibility result for groups of \textit{at least three} agents: Any such group can resolve any given allocation problem with an ex-post budget-balanced mechanism that is Bayesian incentive-compatible, interim individually rational, and ex-post Pareto-efficient.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了基于结果的社会偏好下的机制设计。代理人的社会偏好和私人收益均面临不对称信息。我们假设准线性效用和独立类型。我们展示了如何利用关于代理人社会偏好的信息不对称来满足代理人的参与约束。我们的主要结果是一个针对\textit{至少三个}代理人组成的群体的可能性结果：任何这样的群体都可以通过一个事后预算平衡机制来解决任何给定的分配问题，该机制是贝叶斯激励相容的、中期个体理性的和事后帕累托有效的。

articles.title_en: Robust performance evaluation of independent agents
articles.title_cn: 独立代理人的稳健绩效评估
authors: Kambhampati, Ashwin (Department of Economics, United States Naval Academy)
articles.abstract_en: A principal provides incentives for independent agents. The principal cannot observe the agents' actions, nor does she know the entire set of actions available to them. It is shown that an anti-informativeness principle holds: very generally, robustly optimal contracts must link the incentive pay of the agents. In symmetric and binary environments, they must exhibit joint performance evaluation — each agent's pay is increasing in the performance of the other.
articles.abstract_cn: 委托人向独立代理人提供激励。委托人无法观察代理人的行动，也不知道他们可用的全部行动集。研究表明，反信息性原则成立：非常一般地，稳健最优合同必须将代理人的激励薪酬联系起来。在对称和二元环境中，它们必须表现出联合绩效评估——每个代理人的薪酬随另一代理人的绩效而增加。

articles.title_en: Dynamic information preference and communication with diminishing sensitivity over news
articles.title_cn: 动态信息偏好与对消息敏感性递减的沟通
authors: Duraj, Jetlir (Department of Economics, University of Pittsburgh)
He, Kevin (Department of Economics, University of Pennsylvania)
Kevin He
articles.abstract_en: A Bayesian agent experiences gain-loss utility each period over changes in belief about future consumption (``news utility''), with diminishing sensitivity over the magnitude of news. Diminishing sensitivity induces a preference over news skewness: gradual bad news, one-shot good news is worse than one-shot resolution, which is in turn worse than gradual good news, one-shot bad news. So, the agent's preference between gradual information and one-shot resolution can depend on his consumption ranking of different states. In a dynamic cheap-talk framework where a benevolent sender communicates the state over multiple periods, the babbling equilibrium is essentially unique when the receiver is not loss averse. Contrary to the commitment case, more loss-averse receivers may enjoy higher news utility in equilibrium. We characterize the family of gradual good news equilibria when facing such receivers and find the sender conveys progressively larger pieces of good news.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个贝叶斯代理人每期都会经历关于未来消费信念变化的收益-损失效用（“消息效用”），且对消息幅度的敏感性递减。敏感性递减导致了对消息偏度的偏好：逐渐的坏消息、一次性的好消息比一次性解决更差，而一次性解决又比逐渐的好消息、一次性的坏消息更差。因此，代理人在逐渐信息和一次性解决之间的偏好可以取决于他对不同状态的消费排序。在一个仁慈的发送者在多个时期沟通状态的动态廉价交谈框架中，当接收者不是损失厌恶时，闲聊均衡本质上是唯一的。与承诺情形相反，更损失厌恶的接收者在均衡中可能享有更高的消息效用。我们刻画了面对此类接收者时逐渐好消息均衡的族，并发现发送者传递逐渐增大的好消息片段。

articles.title_en: Information transmission in persuasion models with imperfect verification
articles.title_cn: 不完全验证的说服模型中的信息传递
authors: Silva, Francisco (Department of Economics, Deakin University)
Francisco Silva
articles.abstract_en: I study a persuasion game between a privately informed agent and a decision maker (DM) who can imperfectly verify the statements made by the agent by observing a signal that is correlated with the agent's information. I find that whether or not the DM benefits from communicating with the agent depends on whether the DM's signal and the agent's private information satisfy a weak affiliation condition. I then discuss the significance of this result to the debate over the use of self-appraisals in business. I argue that, in general, self-appraisals are only useful when the workers' abilities are multidimensional.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个说服博弈，参与双方为拥有私人信息的代理人以及决策者（DM），后者可以通过观察与代理人信息相关的信号来不完全验证代理人所作的陈述。我发现，DM是否从与代理人交流中获益取决于DM的信号与代理人的私人信息是否满足一个弱关联条件。随后我讨论了这一结果对商业中使用自我评估的争论的意义。我认为，一般而言，只有当工人的能力是多维度时，自我评估才有用。

articles.title_cn: 宏观经济博弈中的时间一致实施
authors: Barthelemy, Jean (Banque de France)
Mengus, Eric (Department of Economics and Decision Sciences, HEC Paris and CEPR)
Jean Barthelemy
Eric Mengus
articles.abstract_en: The commitment ability of governments is neither infinite nor zero but intermediate. In this paper, we determine the commitment ability that a government needs to implement a unique equilibrium outcome and rule out self-fulfilling expectations. We show that, in a large class of static macroeconomic games, the government can obtain a unique equilibrium with any low level of commitment ability. We finally derive implications for models of bailouts and capital taxation.
articles.abstract_cn: 政府的承诺能力既不是无限的，也不是零，而是介于两者之间。在本文中，我们确定了政府实施唯一均衡结果并排除自我实现预期所需的承诺能力。我们表明，在一大类静态宏观经济博弈中，政府能够以任意低的承诺能力获得唯一均衡。我们最后推导了对救助和资本税模型的启示。

articles.title_en: Robust relational contracts with subjective performance evaluation
articles.title_cn: 具有主观绩效评估的稳健关系契约
authors: Bhaskar, V. (Department of Economics, University of Texas at Austin)
Olszewski, Wojciech (Department of Economics, Northwestern University)
Wiseman, Thomas (Department of Economics, University of Texas at Austin)
Thomas Wiseman
articles.abstract_en: We study a repeated principal-agent model with transferable utility, where the principal's evaluation of the agent's performance is subjective. Our focus is on equilibria which are robust to the addition of small privately observed shocks to the payoffs. Existing constructions of positive-effort equilibria are not robust to such payoff shocks. Allowing for simultaneous cheap-talk announcements makes some effort sustainable in a robust equilibrium, and payoffs can be arbitrarily close to fully efficient ones if players are sufficiently patient. In contrast to the existing literature, our near-efficient equilibria exhibit realistic features: the bonus size is reasonable, the threshold for being paid a bonus is non-trivial, and the base wage need not be negative.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个具有可转移效用的重复委托-代理模型，其中委托人对代理人绩效的评估是主观的。我们的关注点在于对收益中加入小的私人观测冲击具有稳健性的均衡。现有的正努力均衡构造对这种收益冲击并不稳健。允许同时进行廉价交谈公告使得某些努力在稳健均衡中可持续，并且如果参与人足够有耐心，收益可以任意接近完全有效。与现有文献相比，我们的接近有效均衡展现出符合现实的特征：奖金规模合理，获得奖金的阈值并非微不足道，且基本工资不必为负。

articles.title_en: Stable matching in large markets with occupational choice
articles.title_cn: 具有职业选择的大型市场中的稳定匹配
authors: Carmona, Guilherme (School of Economics, University of Surrey)
Laohakunakorn, Krittanai (School of Economics, University of Surrey)
Guilherme Carmona
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a model of large many-to-one matching markets with occupational choice where each individual can choose which side of the market to belong to. We show that stable matchings exist under mild assumptions; in particular, both complementarities and externalities can be accommodated. Our model generalizes Greinecker and Kah (2021), which focuses on one-to-one matching and did not allow for occupational choice. Applications include the roommate problem with non-atomic participants, explaining the size and distribution of firms and wage inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入一个具有职业选择的大型多对一匹配市场模型，其中每个个体可以选择属于市场的哪一侧。我们证明在温和假设下稳定匹配存在；特别地，互补性和外部性都可以被容纳。我们的模型推广了Greinecker和Kah（2021），后者聚焦于一对一匹配且不允许职业选择。应用包括具有非原子参与者的室友问题，解释企业的规模和分布以及工资不平等。
